messages.subject: memory issue with reading Bismark SAM files
parts:
Hei

I am tried  using the AMP pipeline forgenerating the methylation call files from Bismark, but as this pipelone does not support bowtie2, so I used Bismark and tried to read the sorted SAM files. But I am getting the following errors. I am using a computer with 128GB RAM and my sam file is 3GB. Am I running out of memory?

Thanks in advance.

Rafi

> file.list=list("631393_S7_L00X_R1_001.fastq_bismark_bt2.sorted.sam")
> myobj=processBismarkAln(file.list,sample.id=list( "test"),assembly="testdata",treatment=c(1))

 *** caught segfault ***
address 0x8f41, cause 'memory not mapped'
